table_row: A starts before B but ends after B starts | Start order does not establish whole-interval precedence
narrative: Comparing only start anchors (s_A < s_B) can hold while the intervals still overlap (e_A > s_B). Point-anchor ordering in the current v2.4 profile does not establish whole-interval precedence; only the full interval comparison e_A < s_B does. This scenario is a negative case: it exists to stop a future implementation from silently reusing a start-only comparator wherever whole-interval precedes is required.

precedes.subject: A
precedes.basis: e_A(11:00) is not < s_B(10:00); the intervals overlap
